thought.text: Ketemu satu masalah: **prefix `openai/` justru bikin error.** Saya cek kemungkinan lain — format yang dikirim OpenHands.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && K="nmk_live_g1r1I3MMlZDJaclmlAFylupkQulRriMVhSaVx3xR"; echo "=== A. content=list TANPA flag (gaya OpenHands) ==="; curl -s --max-time 60 -X POST "https://api.nomask.ai/v1/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored","messages":[{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"hi"}]}],"max_tokens":30}' -w "
[%{http_code}]
" | head -c 260; echo; echo "=== B. temperature + stream false + top_p ==="; curl -s --max-time 60 -X POST "https://api.nomask.ai/v1/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":30,"temperature":0.7,"top_p":1,"stream":false,"force_string_serializer":true}' -w "
[%{http_code}]
" | head -c 200
